name: Cutthroat Rogue
effect: Deal 4 combat. You may discard a card to draw a card.
flavor: Coin or conscience — only one pays rent.

name: Smuggler's Cache
effect: Gain 3 gold. You may put a card from your discard on top of your deck.
flavor: No manifest, no questions.

name: Poisonblade Enforcer
effect: GUARD. Deal 4 combat on attack. Opponent discards 1 card when this champion attacks.
flavor: She doesn't negotiate.

name: Fence & Informant
effect: Gain 2 gold and deal 2 combat. Expunge a card from your discard pile.
ally_effect: Guild ally: Acquire any card costing 3 or less for free.
flavor: Information is the oldest currency.

name: Imperial Legionnaire
effect: GUARD. Deal 3 combat. Gain 1 health when you play an Imperial card.
flavor: The empire does not ask twice.

name: Royal Decree
effect: Draw 2 cards. You may put one card from your hand on top of your deck.
flavor: Sealed in gold wax, ignored in red tape.

name: Battle Standard
effect: Deal 5 combat. Gain 3 health. Gain 1 gold.
ally_effect: Imperial ally: All champions you control deal +2 combat this turn.
flavor: Plant it. They will rally.

name: Court Mage
effect: GUARD. When played: draw a card. Action: deal 3 combat or gain 3 health.
ally_effect: Imperial ally: Deal 3 combat and draw a card.
flavor: Power is spells. Influence is everything else.

name: Grave Revenant
effect: When this champion is stunned, return it to your hand instead of your discard.
ally_effect: Necros ally: Sacrifice a card in hand to deal 3 combat.
flavor: Death is just a brief inconvenience.

name: Soul Harvest
effect: Deal 3 combat. Expunge up to 2 cards from your discard. Draw 1 card per card expunged.
ally_effect: Necros ally: Opponent loses 2 health for each card expunged.
flavor: Every soul has a use, eventually.

name: Lich Channeler
effect: Expunge a card from your hand. Draw 2 cards and gain 3 health.
flavor: What is memory to one who has outlived meaning?

name: Bone Golem
effect: GUARD. This champion's combat +1 for each card expunged this turn (max +4).
ally_effect: Necros ally: Expunge target card from opponent's discard.
flavor: Assembled from regret. Fueled by spite.

name: Thornwood Ranger
effect: GUARD. When you play a Wild card, gain 1 health.
ally_effect: Wild ally: Put a Wild card from your discard into your hand.
flavor: The forest doesn't forgive trespass.

name: Pack Alpha
effect: Deal 4 combat. Gain 2 health.
ally_effect: Wild ally: Put any champion you control back in your hand; re-play it this turn.
flavor: The pack feeds first. Always.

name: Ancient Grove
effect: Gain 3 gold and 5 health.
ally_effect: Wild ally: Acquire any card costing 4 or less and put it on top of your deck.
flavor: Older than the empire. Older than its ruins.

name: Storm Hawk
effect: When played, gain 1 gold. Action: deal 2 combat.
flavor: Rides the thermals above the carnage below.

name: Wandering Merchant
effect: Gain 3 gold.
flavor: Everything has a price. He just knows it sooner.

name: Fire Gem
effect: Deal 3 combat. Expunge this card after playing it.
flavor: One good burn.

name: Short Sword
effect: Deal 4 combat.
flavor: Simple. Honest. Sharp.

name: Gold Vein
effect: Gain 5 gold and 5 health.
flavor: The vein runs deep if you know where to dig.
